thread:
Maya: quick check — we need one final run of the 'bundle simulator' copy + logic before Thursday launch. goal: FAQ updates, new tier labels, and the cost-preview widget all land together. who can own QA?
Liam: I can do the copy pass for FAQ and tier microcopy. will need the latest variant names though.
Priya: putting the three naming options in a doc rn — sharing in a sec. preference leaning to more descriptive names (eg. 'Starter, Growth, Enterprise') vs. value-led (eg. 'Launch, Scale, Mission').
Jon: for the simulator: analytics needs to capture variant id + selected addons. plz ensure embed adds `utm_experiment=bundle-sim` and `variant=...` to inbound leads.
Sasha: noted. also recommend we wire the simulator leads to the 'pricing-inbound' queue but tag high-touch if monthly projection > $5k. rules sample: `if projected_MRR > 5000 then tag:high-touch`.
Maya: perfect. Priya — can you paste the three name sets here? want to pick by EOD.
Priya: Option A: Starter / Scale / Enterprise
Option B: Launch / Growth / Mission
Option C: Base / Plus / Premium (short labels)
Priya: + suggested microcopy for each (one-liners):
- Starter: "Low-cost inference for prototypes and early users."
- Scale: "Optimized throughput and predictable capacity for product teams."
- Enterprise: "SLA-backed private deployments and dedicated support."
Liam: thumbs up to Option B for external marketing — more emotional. Option A feels prescriptive for the calculator UI though.
Jon: from telemetry POV Option A gives clearer expectation mapping to capacity tiers. we can show a toggle: marketing label vs technical label.
Sasha: about the FAQ: we should add 2 blurbs — (1) "what affects estimated cost?" and (2) "can I pin a version/quantize?" short copy here: "estimates reflect typical token counts, model variant, and optional add-ons like KV cache. pinning a model may change unit price — see dedicated plans."
Maya: love that. Liam pls drop those into the FAQ doc and mark which ones are live copy vs staged. also update the webinar blurb to call out the simulator demo.
Liam: will do. adding a short CTA for webinar signups on the widget: "See cost in real time — join our launch webinar" with link `https://redwood.ai/webinar-pricing-3-21?utm_source=bundle_sim`
marketing-bot: deploy-preview created: https://app.internal/previews/bundle-sim/v5 (expires in 24h)
Priya: preview looks good but the calculator math seemed off for quantized options — shows same as unquantized. tagging @Jon.
Jon: looking — small bug: quantized multiplier wasn't applied when 'cache' checkbox is true. patching now, will push a hotfix and regenerate preview.
Maya: timeline: hotfix + QA by Jon/Liam by 3pm, final copy by Priya by 4pm, analytics event names confirmed by Jon (event: `bundle_sim_submit`, props: `variant`, `projected_mrr`, `addons`), route mapping to pricing-inbound by Sasha tonight.
Sasha: I will update routing and create a dashboard tile for projected MRR >5k leads. also setting a Slack alert to #sales when high-touch lead hits.
Liam: tiny ask — can marketing-bot post the final preview link here once the hotfix is up so I can grab screenshots for the launch post?
marketing-bot: acknowledged — will auto-post updated preview when deploy completes.
Maya: thanks team. last: quick A/B plan for page hero line tied to variant: we run Option B headline vs Option A headline for 72h, measure signups + simulator conversions. low-friction.
Priya: adding experiment cell to the sheet now and will drop the tracking params.
Jon: deployed hotfix at 14:28, preview regenerated: https://app.internal/previews/bundle-sim/v6
Liam: grabbing screenshots. Maya — want me to draft the launch post or you?
Maya: I can draft the short post + benchmark narrative. Liam, please do the assets. Jon/Sasha — if everything is green after 4pm we go live with the widget and wire webinar promo.
Sasha: on it. will post status update in #launches when routing is complete. :white_check_mark:
Maya: great — thanks all.
